name: 073 Word of Ending
description: Neutral fixture (shape of SRD 5.2.1 p.154 Power Word Kill's threshold death, without its damage fallback): a living creature with 30 or fewer Hit Points dies outright; constructs and undead are not eligible. A living creature already at 0 Hit Points also dies.

name: 073 Unmaking
description: Neutral fixture: a living humanoid is destroyed outright with no remains; nonmagical gear is destroyed. A target already at 0 Hit Points is refused.
